title: Crushing chest pain at the dacha
presenting_complaint: Central crushing chest pain radiating to the jaw for 50 minutes, started while chopping wood.
history: Sweaty, nauseated, vomited once. Type 2 diabetes on metformin, hypertension on ramipril, smokes 20 cigarettes/day. No prior MI. No recent surgery or bleeding, no history of stroke.

findings.name: ECG
findings.value: Sinus bradycardia, ST elevation 3 mm in II, III, aVF with reciprocal ST depression in I and aVL

findings.name: Chest X-ray
findings.value: Normal heart size, no pulmonary oedema

diagnosis_options.label: Acute inferior STEMI with right ventricular involvement
NSTEMI
diagnosis_options.explanation: Acute MI, but the ECG shows ST elevation.

management_options.label: Sublingual nitroglycerin
management_options.explanation: Precipitates profound hypotension in RV infarction.
